description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of training examples and the overall ROUGE-G score for various models. The x-axis is labeled "# Training Examples", has a logarithmic scale, and ranges from 0 to 64 with tick labels at 0, 16, and 64. The y-axis is labeled "Overall ROUGE-G Score", has a linear scale, and ranges from 11.0 to 19.0 with tick labels at intervals of 2.0. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Pegasus-X (blue, solid line, triangle marker) starts at approximately 11.0 and increases to around 17.0; Pegasus-X (5%) (green, dashed line, triangle marker) begins at about 16.0 and rises to 18.5; Centrum (red, solid line, square marker) starts at roughly 13.0, dips to 12.0, and then increases to 18.5; Centrum (5%) (yellow, dashed line, square marker) begins at approximately 15.0 and increases to 16.5; Primera (green, solid line, circle marker) starts at around 17.0 and remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 18.0; Primera (5%) (yellow, dashed line, circle marker) begins at about 15.5 and increases to 17.0. Each line exhibits a distinct trend across the x-axis, with some displaying steady increases, while others show more variability.
